title: Multiplicity count and algebraic-degree bound for co-axial spherical metrics with three positive noninteger angles and one integer angle of matching parity
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) article 040, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2024.040; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof turns apparentness into a Jacobi-matrix spectral polynomial, factors its curve according to triangular monodromy, and computes factor degrees from a hypergeometric degeneration at infinity. Bézout then gives the exact count with author-defined intersection multiplicities and the degree bound. The sign condition k = theta_infinity + epsilon_0 theta_0 + epsilon_1 theta_1 integral and theta congruent to k modulo two is essential.
author: Zhijie Chen; Chang-Shou Lin; Yifan Yang
